summary: keycap.rs no longer carries a local stamp_galley: its call sites resolve through a re-export to theme::stamp_galley, the single owner. theme.rs retires the unconsumed single-handle slider tokens, and docs/architecture/ui.md now describes the dual-sided Random Mix ratio editors (F10) and the platform key-name resolver for inactive-profile chips (F17). The scoped loop and full gate pass.

THEME-CLEANUP-AND-DOCS-ALIGNMENT.evidence: Dedupe: the keycap.rs copy of stamp_galley is deleted; the module re-exports theme::stamp_galley so mapping.rs's keycap::stamp_galley call sites keep resolving to the single owner, and new widget test ui::keycap::tests::the_legend_stamp_uses_the_shared_theme_offset asserts the keycap legend's two passes sit at max(18 * theme::STAMP_OFFSET_FACTOR, theme::STAMP_OFFSET_MIN), which a divergent local copy would fail; theme's the_label_is_stamped_twice_by_the_shared_approximation still passes. Retirement: SLIDER_RAIL_WIDTH, SLIDER_RAIL_RADIUS, SLIDER_HANDLE_RADIUS, and SLIDER_HANDLE_RADIUS_DRAG are removed from theme.rs; the gate's check/clippy runs across all targets compile, which proves no code references remain (the only remaining mention is the prose comment in the concurrently owned timing.rs, recorded in risks). Docs: ui.md's Random Mix bullet now states that the stored release share is the single value the release box, the press box, and the mixer slider write (F10); the profile-chip bullet now states that keys the snapshot does not name resolve through platform::windows::physical_key_name, the resolver the wire names come from, with the resolved name as the chip's accessible label (F17); the chip-width note drops the retired SC:xx fallback. A final search of ui.md finds no remaining SC:xx/E0:xx, tooltip, or single-editable-side wording.

risks: src/ui/timing.rs still names the retired SLIDER_RAIL_*/SLIDER_HANDLE_RADIUS* tokens in a prose comment (around line 35); that file belongs to the concurrent T10 task, so the wording is a follow-up for its owner.

The branch was synced to the pinned base_commit 2409bd7 with a conflict-free local merge before implementing; the merge brought the wave-3 files (header, preview, timing, state, language) into the branch and dropped .orchestrator/reports/T3-PROFILES.json and T6-APP-TABLE.json at the tip, matching the integration line. Those report commits remain in history and no report was rewritten.

This cleanup is verified by widget tests and the full gate; it changes no rendered geometry, but the stage's native-visual gap in docs/architecture/verification.md (Unverified Areas) still applies to the touched controls.
